Games Action Games Grand Theft Auto GTA 6 exclusive leads Edge 430 - check out the 16-page cover feature that includes interviews with Rockstar, bespoke screenshots, and more this week News By Iain Harris Published 27 October 2026 You can even read that cover feature for free When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here's how it works . (Image credit: Future) Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The latest issue of Edge magazine is out this week, and it isn't one to miss for GTA 6 fans. As part of Edge 430, the team has paid Rockstar a visit at its Edinburgh HQ to talk all things GTA 6. The issue's huge 16-page cover story features exclusive interviews and imagery detailing the most ambitious project in Rockstar's history, wrapped up with a special gatefold cover showcasing artwork of lead characters Jason and Lucia. Check out the sneak peek below: The new issue of Edge magazine will go on sale October 29, but the good news doesn't stop there. To coincide with the release, the full feature will be released for you to read online for free right here on GamesRadar+. Just follow the link provided on the day. Those of you in the UK can get a collector's edition for free, plus 13 issues of Edge at 38% off the newsstand price, by subscribing at the link . You'll need to be quick, though, as that's while stocks last. If you're interested, you can subscribe here . The GTA 6-led version of Edge is the latest slice of new information we're getting in the build-up to the long-awaited launch next month. That all truly kicked off with GTA 6's extended look on Netflix at the end of August, though we've had plenty since to tease what's on the way. Do you work in videogames?
